**4.1 Internal Audit Observations – Q2 FY2024**

The internal audit team completed a limited-scope review of the grant disbursement process for the period 1 April 2024 to 30 June 2024. The review covered a sample of 18 payment vouchers, including all vouchers above SGD 10,000.00. The following observations were noted:

- **Observation IA-2024-07 (Medium):** For PV-2024-024 (AidLink Foundation, Phase 2 tranche), the supporting documentation did not include a signed acknowledgement of receipt from the grantee at the time of processing. The payment was released based on the approved disbursement schedule and the M&E checkpoint report. The acknowledgement was subsequently obtained and filed on 2-Jul-2024. Action: Reminder issued to the grants team on 5-Jul-2024 to ensure acknowledgements are obtained prior to or at the point of disbursement for all future tranches.

- **Observation IA-2024-08 (Low):** The pre-disbursement advance (PV-2024-028) to PRGN was recorded as a grant expense in the general ledger rather than as a receivable/advance. This treatment is consistent with prior cycles but does not align with the revised accounting policy on advances (Policy FIN-2023-11). The advance is expected to be offset against the July disbursement; the finance team will reverse and reclassify the entry upon offset. Action: Journal entry to be prepared by 15-Jul-2024.

- **Observation IA-2024-09 (Low):** Bank charges (PV-2024-030) were not individually approved by the Finance Manager, as the charge is a recurring monthly fee under the corporate account agreement. Noted for information.

No material findings were raised. The audit team noted that the overall control environment for grant disbursements remains satisfactory.

**4.1 Internal Audit Observations – Q2 FY2024**

The internal audit team completed a limited-scope review of the grant disbursement process for the period 1 April 2024 to 30 June 2024. The review covered a sample of 18 payment vouchers, including all vouchers above SGD 10,000.00. The following observations were noted:

- **Observation IA-2024-07 (Medium):** For PV-2024-024 (AidLink Foundation, Phase 2 tranche), the supporting documentation did not include a signed acknowledgement of receipt from the grantee at the time of processing. The payment was released based on the approved disbursement schedule and the M&E checkpoint report. The acknowledgement was subsequently obtained and filed on 2-Jul-2024. - **Observation IA-2024-08 (Low):** The pre-disbursement advance (PV-2024-028) to PRGN was recorded as a grant expense in the general ledger rather than as a receivable/advance. This treatment is consistent with prior cycles but does not align with the revised accounting policy on advances (Policy FIN-2023-11).
